indicators.name: Arnaud Legoux Moving Average
indicators.description: A smooth, low-lag average that weights the window with a bell curve placed near the newest bars.

indicators.name: Double EMA
indicators.description: An exponential average with the lag partly removed (2*EMA minus EMA of EMA), so it hugs price more closely.

indicators.name: EMA Cross
indicators.description: Two exponential averages; the fast one crossing above the slow one is read as bullish, below as bearish.

indicators.name: Exponential Moving Average
indicators.description: An average of recent closes that weights newer prices more, so it reacts faster than a simple average.

indicators.name: Guppy Multiple Moving Average
indicators.description: Two bundles of EMAs (short-term traders and long-term investors); a wide, fanned-out bundle signals a strong trend.

indicators.name: Hull Moving Average
indicators.description: A fast, smooth moving average that cuts lag; a turn up or down in its slope is read as a trend change.

indicators.name: Least Squares Moving Average
indicators.description: The end of a best-fit straight line through the last N closes; it shows the current linear trend.

indicators.name: MA Cross
indicators.description: Two simple averages; a buy signal is read when the fast one crosses above the slow one, a sell when below.

indicators.name: McGinley Dynamic
indicators.description: A self-adjusting average that speeds up when price moves fast and slows down when it is quiet.

indicators.name: Moving Average Adaptive (Kaufman)
indicators.description: An average that flattens in choppy, sideways markets and speeds up in clean trends (Kaufman's adaptive MA).

indicators.name: Moving Average Multiple
indicators.description: Four simple averages of different lengths at once; when they are stacked in order the trend is clear.

indicators.name: Simple Moving Average
indicators.description: The plain average of the last N closing prices; price above it suggests an uptrend, below it a downtrend.

indicators.name: Smoothed Moving Average
indicators.description: A slow, very smooth average (Wilder smoothing) that ignores small wiggles and follows the broad trend.

indicators.name: Triple EMA
indicators.description: A three-times smoothed exponential average corrected for lag, reacting quickly while staying smooth.

indicators.name: Volume Weighted Moving Average
indicators.description: A moving average that gives more weight to bars with heavy trading volume, so busy days matter more.

indicators.name: VWAP
indicators.description: The volume-weighted average price since the start of the session (intraday) or month (daily); a fair-price line.

indicators.name: Weighted Moving Average
indicators.description: An average of the last N closes where each newer bar counts proportionally more than the one before.

indicators.name: 52 Week High/Low
indicators.description: The highest high and lowest low of the last 252 trading days (about a year); shows how close price is to its yearly extremes.

indicators.name: Auto Fibonacci Retracement
indicators.description: Fibonacci levels drawn between the highest high and lowest low of the last N bars, often watched as pullback support or resistance.

indicators.name: Bollinger Bands
indicators.description: An average with bands set N standard deviations away; price near the outer bands is stretched, tight bands warn of a squeeze.

indicators.name: Chande Kroll Stop
indicators.description: Trailing stop levels based on volatility: exit longs below the long stop, shorts above the short stop.

indicators.name: Donchian Channels
indicators.description: The highest high and lowest low of the last N bars with their midpoint; a close above the top is a breakout.

indicators.name: Envelopes
indicators.description: A moving average with lines a fixed percentage above and below it; price reaching a line is stretched.

indicators.name: Ichimoku Cloud
indicators.description: A cloud of support and resistance: price above the cloud is bullish, below bearish. The lagging span is omitted because it would need future bars.

indicators.name: Keltner Channels
indicators.description: An EMA with bands a multiple of the average true range away; closes outside the channel suggest a strong move.

indicators.name: Moving Average Channel
indicators.description: A channel made from the average of the highs and the average of the lows; price above it is strong, below weak.

indicators.name: Pivot Points Standard
indicators.description: Support (S) and resistance (R) levels computed from the previous bar's high, low and close.

indicators.name: Price Channel
indicators.description: The highest high and lowest low of the N bars before today; price closing outside it is a breakout.

indicators.name: Aroon
indicators.description: Measures how recently price made its highest high and lowest low; Aroon Up near 100 means a fresh high, so an uptrend.

indicators.name: Aroon Oscillator
indicators.description: Aroon Up minus Aroon Down: positive means highs are more recent than lows (uptrend), negative the opposite.

indicators.name: Average Directional Index
indicators.description: ADX measures how strong a trend is (above about 25 is trending, below 20 is weak) without saying which way; +DI and -DI show direction.

indicators.name: Choppiness Index
indicators.description: Tells trending from sideways markets: above 61.8 the market is choppy and range-bound, below 38.2 it is trending.

indicators.name: Directional Movement
indicators.description: +DI above -DI means buyers are in control, -DI above +DI means sellers; ADX adds how strong the trend is.

indicators.name: Elder-Ray Index
indicators.description: Bull power is how far the high is above an EMA and bear power how far the low is below it, showing buyer and seller strength.

indicators.name: Mass Index
indicators.description: Watches the widening and narrowing of the high-low range; a rise above 27 that falls back below 26.5 warns of a reversal.

indicators.name: Parabolic SAR
indicators.description: Dots that trail price and accelerate with the trend: dots under price are bullish, above are bearish, and a flip warns of a reversal.

indicators.name: Supertrend
indicators.description: A trailing line that sits under price in an uptrend and over price in a downtrend; a flip of colour signals a trend change.

indicators.name: TRIX
indicators.description: The rate of change of a triple-smoothed EMA of price; crossing above zero is bullish and below zero bearish.

indicators.name: Vortex Indicator
indicators.description: Two lines that capture upward and downward movement; VI+ crossing above VI- suggests a new uptrend.

indicators.name: Williams Alligator
indicators.description: Three smoothed averages (jaw, teeth, lips): when they are tangled the market is asleep, when they fan out a trend is feeding.

indicators.name: Zig Zag
indicators.description: Connects the major swing highs and lows, ignoring moves smaller than the deviation percent; the last leg can change as new bars arrive.

indicators.name: Accelerator Oscillator
indicators.description: Shows whether momentum itself is speeding up or slowing down (the Awesome Oscillator minus its 5-bar average).

indicators.name: Awesome Oscillator
indicators.description: The 5-bar minus 34-bar average of the median price; bars above zero show bullish momentum, below zero bearish.

indicators.name: Balance of Power
indicators.description: Measures who won each bar, buyers or sellers, as (close - open) / (high - low) between -1 and 1; positive means buyers.

indicators.name: Chande Momentum Oscillator
indicators.description: Compares total up-moves with total down-moves over N bars on a -100 to 100 scale; above 50 is overbought, below -50 oversold.

indicators.name: Commodity Channel Index
indicators.description: Measures how far the typical price is from its average; readings beyond +100 or -100 show unusually strong moves.

indicators.name: Connors RSI
indicators.description: Averages a short RSI, the RSI of the up/down streak length and the percentile rank of today's change; extremes flag short-term reversals.

indicators.name: Coppock Curve
indicators.description: A weighted average of two rates of change, designed to spot long-term market bottoms when it turns up from below zero.

indicators.name: Detrended Price Oscillator
indicators.description: Removes the trend to show cycles: today's close minus a moving average from about half a period ago.

indicators.name: Fisher Transform
indicators.description: Reshapes prices so turning points show as sharp peaks; the Fisher line crossing its trigger line signals a reversal.

indicators.name: Know Sure Thing
indicators.description: Adds up four smoothed rates of change (short to long term) into one momentum line; crossing its signal line is the usual trigger.

indicators.name: MACD
indicators.description: The gap between a fast and a slow EMA with a signal line; the MACD crossing above its signal is bullish, below bearish.

indicators.name: Momentum
indicators.description: Today's close minus the close N bars ago; positive values mean price is rising, negative falling.

indicators.name: Price Oscillator
indicators.description: Like MACD but expressed as a percentage of the slow EMA, so values are comparable between shares of different prices.

indicators.name: Rate Of Change
indicators.description: The percentage change in price over the last N bars; above zero means price is higher than N bars ago.

indicators.name: Relative Strength Index
indicators.description: Compares recent gains with recent losses on a 0-100 scale; above 70 is often called overbought, below 30 oversold.

indicators.name: Relative Vigor Index
indicators.description: Compares where bars close relative to where they open, on the idea that closes are higher than opens in uptrends.

indicators.name: Relative Volatility Index
indicators.description: Like RSI but built from the standard deviation of price instead of price changes; high values mean volatility is rising with price.

indicators.name: SMI Ergodic Indicator
indicators.description: A smoothed momentum ratio between -1 and 1 (the true strength index) with a signal line; crossings of the signal show momentum shifts.

indicators.name: Stochastic
indicators.description: Shows where the close sits within the recent high-low range; above 80 is stretched high, below 20 stretched low.

indicators.name: Stochastic RSI
indicators.description: A stochastic applied to the RSI instead of price, so it swings faster between overbought (above 80) and oversold (below 20).

indicators.name: True Strength Index
indicators.description: A double-smoothed momentum reading; crossing above zero or above its signal line is bullish, below bearish.

indicators.name: Ultimate Oscillator
indicators.description: Blends buying pressure over three time frames into one 0-100 reading; above 70 is overbought, below 30 oversold.

indicators.name: Williams %R
indicators.description: Shows where the close is within the recent range from -100 (at the low) to 0 (at the high); above -20 is overbought, below -80 oversold.

indicators.name: Average True Range
indicators.description: The average size of a bar's full price range, including gaps; higher means a more volatile share, useful for sizing stops.

indicators.name: Bollinger Bands %B
indicators.description: Where price sits inside the Bollinger Bands: 1 is at the upper band, 0 at the lower band, beyond that is outside them.

indicators.name: Bollinger Bands Width
indicators.description: How wide the Bollinger Bands are relative to their average; very low values (a squeeze) often come before big moves.

indicators.name: Historical Volatility
indicators.description: The annualised standard deviation of daily price changes, in percent; higher means wilder swings.

indicators.name: Standard Deviation
indicators.description: How far closing prices typically stray from their N-bar average, in price units; larger means more volatile.

indicators.name: Ulcer Index
indicators.description: Measures downside risk: how deep and how long price has been below its recent peak; higher means more painful drawdowns.

indicators.name: Volatility Close-to-Close
indicators.description: The annualised sample standard deviation of close-to-close returns, in percent; a standard measure of how much a share swings.

indicators.name: Accumulation/Distribution
indicators.description: A running total of volume weighted by where each bar closes in its range; a rising line means accumulation, falling distribution.

indicators.name: Accumulative Swing Index
indicators.description: Wilder's running total of a swing index that judges the real strength of each bar; new highs in it confirm a price breakout.

indicators.name: Chaikin Money Flow
indicators.description: The share of volume that is buying versus selling over N bars; above zero means buying pressure, below zero selling.

indicators.name: Chaikin Oscillator
indicators.description: The difference between a fast and slow EMA of Accumulation/Distribution; above zero means buying pressure is building.

indicators.name: Ease of Movement
indicators.description: Shows how easily price moves per unit of volume; positive values mean price rises on light volume.

indicators.name: Elder's Force Index
indicators.description: Price change times volume, smoothed; positive means buyers are forcing price up, negative means sellers are pushing it down.

indicators.name: Klinger Oscillator
indicators.description: Tracks long-term money flow with short-term sensitivity; the KVO crossing above its signal line is bullish.

indicators.name: Money Flow Index
indicators.description: A volume-weighted RSI on a 0-100 scale; above 80 suggests overbought, below 20 oversold.

indicators.name: Net Volume
indicators.description: Volume counted as positive on up days and negative on down days; shows which side traded more shares each bar.

indicators.name: On Balance Volume
indicators.description: A running total that adds volume on up days and subtracts it on down days; a rising line shows buying pressure.

indicators.name: Price Volume Trend
indicators.description: A running total of volume scaled by the percentage price change; like OBV but it counts how big each move was.

indicators.name: Volume
indicators.description: The number of shares traded each bar with its moving average; a price move on high volume is more convincing.

indicators.name: Volume Oscillator
indicators.description: The percentage gap between a fast and slow volume average; rising values mean volume is picking up.

indicators.name: Average Price
indicators.description: The average of open, high, low and close, a smooth line through the middle of each candle.

indicators.name: Median Price
indicators.description: The midpoint of each bar's high and low; ignores where the bar opened and closed.

indicators.name: Typical Price
indicators.description: The average of each bar's high, low and close; a single representative price for the bar.

indicators.name: Weighted Close
indicators.description: The average of high, low and close (counted twice), so the close carries the most weight.
